value.rationale: The necessary-and-sufficient realizability theorem answers a motivated inverse problem about all scalar dynamical thresholds, revealing sharp constraints on allowable exceptional sets and showing sufficiency simultaneously for three properties. The Cantor application creates dense coexistence of distinct strong-expansivity regimes inside a common nonhyperbolic spectrum without an AE obstruction. This is a natural complete classification rather than another fixed-operator corollary or arbitrarily chosen cutoff.
